name: Veronica Lauria
office: Valle Lindo School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Veronica Lauria is the President of the Valle Lindo School District Governing Board. She is an incumbent board member. She supports Measure R, a $9.2 million bond on the November 2026 ballot. The measure would fund renovation and repair projects at the district's two schools through a property tax increase.
